conclusion: Vocoder-only reconstruction retains recognized words. Source-token acoustic reconstruction changes a phrase according to both recognizers. Higher DNSMOS does not establish fidelity. Investigate tokenizer/acoustic decoding rather than assuming the vocoder alone causes all defects.
limitation: One six-second excerpt with a sentence cut at its end. Generated TTS has different timing. Speaker cosine to other heldout source clips is style-sensitive.
